content.title: How to watch Illinois vs. UConn men’s basketball: Semifinals TV channel and streaming options for April 4
content.text: The No. 13 Illinois Fighting Illini (28-8) will try to build on a four-game winning streak when they visit the No. 7 UConn Huskies (33-5) at 6:09 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 4, 2026. The Huskies have also won four games in a row.How to watch Illinois Fighting Illini vs. UConn Huskies Venue: Lucas Oil Stadium Time: 6:09 p.m. ET TV: TBS Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. It is making 2.3 more threes than its opponents, who drain 5.9 per game at 30.7%.
